items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: Two men once played with my big band with him at the time. He had Eugene Porter. And he had Earl Bostic.

ctx.x: Yeah. He had a band. And he had a... He had a fellow... Two men once played with my big band with him at the time. He had Eugene Porter. And he had Earl Bostic. Earl Bostic had left. And went to Ohio. And went to New York. And he got to play...
Where did Earl Bostic come from? He wasn't from here, was he? No.
